srList.sentence: Study population The study population comprised 5,440 children who had a Tasmanian 2015 AEDC instrument collected in the first year of full time school at age five years (i.e., Preparatory Year) and a Tasmanian Perinatal Baby Record collected in all Tasmanian public and private hospitals for all live births and stillbirths of at least 20 weeks gestation or weighing at least 400 grams.

srList.sentence: Birth risks The risk variables obtained from the Perinatal Baby Records were: low birth weight ( less than 2500 grams) , low gestational age ( less than 37 completed weeks ) and multiple birth .
